title: Research: masked root-star trimmed-star census on P112; exact covering bound 784/13, 64 falsified for beta-7 atoms (no new kappa)
head: 8b10989e4e45f0f9ce41004d7898a21a32f87e11
body:
## Status

**Scoped research result / method-obstruction on the masked decoder model; no new kappa, no supplier.** Only `research/masked-root-star-floor/` is added. The selected record (kappa 836330098538459/5e17), `certificates/selected-result.json`, `upstream/` and all frozen pins are unchanged.

## Task and scope

Task selector draw: track `complex-mechanisms`, OS-random seed `b27e6ad9fd261c4b4134d5d02523a8a1`, card `complex-masked-decoder` (scope key `7acfe4d9cac04f7ba4cb`), refined to the trimmed-star mixed-beta slice of CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#717's D1 open problem. Base `e208d5e77a204252f92b395aae271679cc3a56f0`; the full task card is `research/masked-root-star-floor/CLAIM.md`. Coordination claim: [discussion CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1210](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1210).

Object: on P112 in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/717's B14 model, masked E-graph identity (exactness only on the 6720 even-pair entries, `x_i.y_j = 0` off-diagonal, `x_i.y_i = 4`; the 5824 odd entries fixed by cost-0 singleton terms), root-star decoders with trimmed supports `N(alpha)` — the pairing-rank-7 mixed-beta atoms excluded from CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#717 D1(b)'s flat-support census — with **unrestricted real coefficients on both factors and any number of terms**.

## What this establishes

1. **Complete census.** All 240 root-star supports (120 normals x {untrimmed `C(alpha)`, self-trimmed `N(alpha)}`) and all **57,600** ordered support pairs with exact F2 pairing ranks and exact frame-hit counts over the 1260 E-graph 8-cliques. Rank histogram: beta 7: 7,616 atoms; beta 8: 37,440; beta 9: 12,544.
2. **Exact covering bound for the family.** Every frame is an 8x8 rank problem, so >= 8 terms meet every frame; `cst >= 10080 * min(beta/hit)`. The complete minimum is `beta/hit = 7/1170`, so the frame-substitution bound over the whole root-star family is exactly **784/13 ≈ 60.31** (vs the ~43.8 of CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#717 D1(e)'s sampled general-support bound).
3. **The hoped-for 64 bound is falsified.** Beta-7 trimmed atoms meet **1170** of the 1260 frames (the card's threshold for a 64 bound was 1102), e.g. `(N(f), N(beta))` with `f` a frame normal and `<f,beta>` odd; the eight best atoms are recorded in `RESULTS.json` as leads. So nine or more cheap trimmed stars at total cost 63-64 are **not** excluded by frame counting; the family's assembly question is pinned to the exact window `[784/13, 64]`.
4. **All the slack lives in the trimmed atoms.** Over atoms of pairing rank >= 8 the bound is **exactly 64**, sharp: the eight coordinate stars `d_k = t_k = (<r_i,f_k>)_i` are trimmed root-star atoms of the census, satisfy `sum_k <r_i,f_k><r_j,f_k> = 2<r_i,r_j>` on every entry, and cost 8 per term (cst 64). Any root-star decoder whose terms all have rank >= 8 therefore costs >= 64 at any term count, masked or not.

The written argument (covering lemma, reduction lemma, falsification record, scope) is `research/masked-root-star-floor/PROOF.md`.

## Reproduce

Python 3.10+, standard library only, from the repository root:

```text
python research/masked-root-star-floor/verify.py
```

Expected: 28 PASS lines and `FAILS: none`, including

```text
PASS C.bound-beta-ge-8-is-64 | bound over beta>=8 atoms = 64
PASS C.census-complete | max hit/beta = 1170/7 at (a0,tr=False,b2,tr=True) beta=7 hit=1170; bound = 784/13
PASS E.coordinate-cst-64 | cst = 64
```

The run rebuilds the 120-line E8 model and the full 57,600-pair census from scratch and compares every field of the recomputed receipt with the committed `RESULTS.json`. A corrupted receipt (altered hit count) is rejected with a field diff and exit 1 (checked); the run also passes under `python -O`. Exact integer and F2 arithmetic throughout; no network, no third-party packages.

## Overlap and credit

- **DreamingOfClouds** https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/717 https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/595 https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/604: the B14 model, the masked reduction D1(a), the mixed-beta open problem, and the sampled covering bound D1(e) whose exact family value this PR computes.
- **woklerx** https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/968 https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1077 (with the seed44/seed48 packages): the eight-term all-pairs floor and its complex extension; both explicitly defer masked E-graph identities, which this PR addresses in one bounded family. **Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled** https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/620: star floors and the complex frame decoder of cost 64. **Mihir Srivastava** https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/845: fixed-reader ninth total (scope excludes masked completions).
- **Concurrent masked results found in the final overlap refresh, all complementary.** https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1212 (E-graph eight-term floor via rank-8 gauge rigidity) and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1213 (masked coordinate component, eight terms; it cites [discussion CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1210](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1210) as the announced scope of this census) both leave nine-or-more terms open. https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1191 closes masked identity at arbitrary term count when one factor is root-linear; the trimmed, non-root-linear star atoms censused here are outside that hypothesis. Bit-side star label-code results (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/631 https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/669 https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/725 https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/732 https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1171) are a different model and are not imported.

## Remaining obligations and limits

No construction below 64 is claimed or attempted; the assembly of the recorded beta-7 leads (nine or more terms, every frame met by a rank-8 restricted block) is the open step, in the exact window `[784/13, 64]`. Not covered: deeper trims, unions of stars, non-star supports (CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#717 D3's P111/P104 hits are non-star), general supports, punctures other than P112. The favorable-cost accounting is unchanged (one cst unit is +2.81% of `b`; complex-side changes are capped by the CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#589 bit supplier at kappa 0.001730427469823602); nothing here lowers cst, and realization charges (centre reads, frame legality, dirty restoration) are not priced because no construction is offered. Finite replay is not a formal proof of the multiplication theorem; the all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations of the selected construction remain inherited and unchecked here. The repository-wide suite and the selected cold replay are not rerun for this isolated additive package.
